class.name: GsqPagedChunkPayloadSource
class.brief_description: File-backed [ChunkPayloadSource] for worlds stored as compressed GSQ pages.
class.description: A [ChunkPayloadSource] for [code].gsplatworld[/code] files whose chunks are runs of GSQ v1 pages. Only the page directory is kept resident. A capture reads the pages it needs on a reader pool, checks each page against its directory entry and digests, and decodes it on the calling thread, which on the streaming route is a pack worker. A page that fails a check fails the capture with a reason; nothing is skipped or repaired.

method.name: get_decode_stats
method.description: Returns the source's counters: captures, failed captures, pages and splats decoded, decode time in nanoseconds ([code]decode_nsec[/code]) with its stored-page verify ([code]verify_nsec[/code]), zstd decompression ([code]zstd_nsec[/code]) and decoded-digest ([code]digest_nsec[/code]) shares, pages decoded on worker threads and on the main thread, page failures with the last failure reason, and the read pool's request and byte counters.
